# uptimeify Provider

Manage Uptimeify resources through the Uptimeify REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11"
  required_providers {
    uptimeify = {
      source = "uptimeify/uptimeify"
    }
  }
}

# endpoint and api_token fall back to UPTIMEIFY_ENDPOINT and UPTIMEIFY_API_TOKEN.
provider "uptimeify" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Organization API token (`wsm_...`) or customer token. Falls back to `UPTIMEIFY_API_TOKEN`.
- `endpoint` (String) API base URL. Falls back to `UPTIMEIFY_ENDPOINT`, then `https://uptimeify.io`.
